content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation on § 13.1 (p0052).**

- **Problem:** § 13.1 grants the Services licence to "Customer alone", expressly "without Affiliates or contractors", and "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion". Since the defined *Customer* is Meridian Fieldworks alone (§ 1.1/p0001 definitions confirm Affiliates are separate entities), affiliates and contractors are excluded with no notice path — walk-away territory, failing even the fallback. The at-will revocation also contradicts the retained revocation limit in § 13.3.
- **Already met elsewhere (not re-drafted):** § 13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence to Customer and its Affiliates for paid-up software/Vendor Technology; § 13.3 with § 24.1 permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in a merger/acquisition without Vendor consent.
- **Cure (one surgical replace, validated ok:true):** § 13.1 now grants the licence to "Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf … terminable only for Customer's uncured material breach". Deleting "non-transferable" removes the dangling conflict with the § 13.3 transfer right; no other text was touched.
